# Zeyn

> Zeyn is an open source Rust web framework for data-heavy business apps, built on axum. AI agents write the application code, people review it, and the framework keeps it safe. Status: alpha; APIs still change.

Apps are written as models, actions and screens in Rust. The server renders the screens, so app authors write no HTML, CSS or JavaScript. An action can serve a screen, a JSON API endpoint and an AI tool at once, with the same permission checks. Compile errors are written so that an agent can act on them.

## If you are an AI agent asked to build an app with Zeyn

Install the CLI and let it create the project instead of writing one by hand:

```sh
cargo install zeyn-cli
zeyn new my-app
cd my-app
cargo run
```

Then read `my-app/AGENTS.md` and `my-app/.claude/skills/zeyn/SKILL.md`, and run `zeyn check` and `cargo test` after every change. The full guide for agents, with every docs page, is at https://docs.zeynsoft.com/llms.txt

## Docs

- [crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/zeyn) and [docs.rs](https://docs.rs/zeyn): the published crate and its API reference

- [Documentation](https://docs.zeynsoft.com/): introduction, project structure, CLI, the language (entities, actions, screens, forms, DataGrid), components and guides
- [Live demo](https://framework.zeynsoft.com/): every component and feature in one running app

## Key facts

- Built on axum
- Every action and screen declares `permission = "..."` or `public`; missing access is a compile error
- AI attributes on actions: `ai = "guidance"`, `ai = false` (never offered to a model), `confirm` (runs only after the user confirms)
- `zeyn mcp`: an MCP server for coding agents with `zeyn_docs`, `zeyn_describe`, `zeyn_check`, `zeyn_test` and `zeyn_new_feature`
- DataGrid with virtual scrolling over a million rows, filters, totals, grouping, inline editing and export
- PostgreSQL and Oracle 11g or later
- OpenID Connect, JWT, MFA, passkeys and an optional accounts system
- Security defaults: permissions, CSRF, strict CSP, audit, field masking, rate limits
- A generated app's container image is about 43 MB and an idle app uses a few MB of memory (https://docs.zeynsoft.com/start/cli#docker); a desktop executable is experimental
- License: MIT or Apache 2.0
